Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (M/M59/M59n1540.xml). General Discourses of Chan Master Dahui Pujue (大慧普覺禪師普說): Dahui Zonggao says the bare and exposed condition has nothing to get hold of while immediately refusing even a clear explanatory annotation.

Senses.Explanation: Nothing to get hold of is the closing verdict in a recurrent formula of being bare and exposed; masters quote it, challenge anyone who merely repeats it, and still demand a further word beyond it. Dahui Zonggao makes the bare, exposed, nothing-to-grasp condition a prerequisite before looking at Yunmen's dried-shit-stick answer. Another Dahui address couples it with ordinary walking, sitting, eating, and warming oneself, but immediately says even this does not yet deserve the name patch-robed monk. Chushi Fanqi joins Nanquan's livelihood to Zhaozhou's breaking up the household and calls the resulting nothing-to-grasp condition delightful. Yinyuan Longqi places it after roundness, exposure, and emptiness; Yi'an Shanzan says even this condition must answer when an ancient buddha meets a pillar; Zhikongyun quotes the whole older formula and then sets his own barrier.
